_meta.title: AI 做游戏 · 立论层三张判定表
_meta.principle: 每条判断必须能回溯到官方源，或显式标注「我们的口径」。v3 铁律第4 条。
_meta.criticalNote: ⚠ **成本下降幅度没有权威来源。** 下面 table-1 的costChange 列是**我们的判断**，不是实测数据。它基于「AI 在该环节能替代什么」的定性推理，不是测量结果。引用时请连同这句一起引用。

table1_whatChanged.title: 表 1 · AI 改变了做游戏的哪部分

rows.basis: 场景图、状态机、ECS 都有官方文档与大量可参考实现；AI 生成的是结构清晰的样板代码，不依赖引擎私有约定。
rows.verifiable: 各引擎的官方 API 文档（见 engines-verified.json 的 repoUrl）
rows.basisEn: Scene trees, state machines and ECS all have official docs and many reference implementations; what AI writes is boilerplate with clear structure, not code depending on engine-private conventions.

rows.basis: 平台跳跃、卡牌、塔防、贪吃蛇这类玩法的核心循环是确定性代码，AI 能可靠产出。
rows.verifiable: 可由 demos 站的收录记录佐证（**该站尚未建，此项待补**）
rows.caveat: ⚠ 「成熟品类」的范围是本站的界定，未做穷举。
rows.basisEn: The core loop of platformers, card games, tower defense and the like is deterministic code, which AI produces reliably.

rows.basis: AI 能给参数（重力、摩擦、跳跃高度），但**「好不好玩」无法自动判定** —— 没有测试能告诉你手感对不对。
rows.verifiable: 无官方源，属方法论判断
rows.basisEn: AI can supply parameters (gravity, friction, jump height), but whether it feels good cannot be judged automatically — no test tells you that.

rows.basis: 单张/单组素材可用；**成套资产的风格一致性仍是生成模型的缺陷**。多轮对话不会让它更一致。
rows.verifiable: 无官方源，属方法论判断
rows.basisEn: Individual assets or small sets are usable; a coherent art style across a full set is still a weakness of image models. More dialogue does not make it more consistent.

rows.basis: 角色/场景的一致性、拓扑可用性、贴图一致性都难以保证；且商用授权存在法律灰区。
rows.verifiable: 无官方源，属方法论判断
rows.basisEn: Character and scene consistency, topology usability and texture coherence all remain hard; commercial licensing is also a legal grey area.

rows.basis: 单点音效与短BGM 可用；**长段配乐的风格稳定性不足**。
rows.verifiable: 无官方源，属方法论判断
rows.basisEn: Single sound effects and short BGM work; style stability across longer pieces does not hold up.

rows.basis: AI 能提出数值方案，但**平衡需反复试玩迭代**，而试玩成本无法压缩。
rows.verifiable: 无官方源，属方法论判断
rows.basisEn: AI can propose numbers, but balance needs repeated playtesting — and playtesting time cannot be compressed.

rows.basis: 这是 LLM 的本职。⚠ 但**仍需人工校对**（事实错误、语气一致性、分支收敛）。
rows.verifiable: 无官方源，属方法论判断
rows.basisEn: This is what LLMs are for. Still needs human editing: factual errors, tone consistency, branch convergence.

rows.basis: 引擎自带导出流水线，AI 帮助有限 —— 这块是**确定性工程**，不是生成任务。
rows.verifiable: 各引擎官方文档的export 章节
rows.basisEn: Engines ship an export pipeline; AI helps little here — this is deterministic engineering, not a generation task.

table2_whatDoesNotCarryOver.title: 表 2 · vibe coding 的哪些前提在游戏里不成立
table2_whatDoesNotCarryOver.intro: vibe coding 的方法论不是万能的。这张表列出它依赖的四个前提，以及游戏开发中哪些不成立。

rows.inGame: 以分钟到小时计 —— 你得玩二十分钟才知道这个跳跃手感对不对
rows.consequence: 迭代节奏慢一个数量级，「快速试错」的优势被削弱
rows.inGameEn: Counts in minutes to hours — you have to play twenty minutes to know whether the jump feels right
rows.consequenceEn: Iteration is an order of magnitude slower, which eats most of the fast-try-error advantage

rows.premise: 结果可自动验证（类型检查、测试、编译）
rows.inGame: **「好不好玩」无法自动判定** —— 没有一个测试能告诉你这个游戏有趣
rows.consequence: ⚠ 最关键的一条：AI 能写出通过所有测试但不好玩的代码
rows.premiseEn: Results are automatically verifiable (type checks, tests, compile)
rows.inGameEn: **Whether it is fun cannot be judged automatically** — no test can tell you this game is enjoyable
rows.consequenceEn: ⚠ The key one: AI can produce code that passes every test and is not fun

rows.inGame: **失败常常是沉默的** —— 游戏能跑、能通关、只是不好玩
rows.consequence: 你可能以为做完了，实际上只是没发现问题
rows.inGameEn: **Failure is often silent** — the game runs, it is completable, it is just not fun
rows.consequenceEn: You may think it is done when you have only failed to notice a problem

rows.inGame: 代码只占产物的一部分 —— 美术、音频、关卡、平衡都是产物
rows.consequence: ⚠ 瓶颈从「写不出来」变成「凑不齐」
rows.inGameEn: Code is only part of the output — art, audio, levels and balance are outputs too
rows.consequenceEn: ⚠ The bottleneck shifts from "cannot write it" to "cannot assemble it"

table2_whatDoesNotCarryOver.introEn: vibe coding's method is not universal. This table lists the premises it relies on, and which of them fail for game development.

table3_fit.title: 表 3 · 什么适合、什么不适合
table3_fit.intro: ⚠ 这张表是**本站的判断**，不是数据。它的用途是给读者一个起点，不是标准答案。

fits.item: Game Jam（48 小时等短周期）
fits.why: 时间盒强制你放弃资产 perfectionism，AI 的代码提速正好补在刀刃上
fits.itemEn: Game Jams and other short time-boxes
fits.whyEn: A time box forces you to drop asset perfectionism, and AI's speedup lands exactly where it helps

fits.why: 核心循环是确定性代码，AI 可靠
fits.whyEn: The core loop is deterministic code, which AI handles reliably

fits.why: 资产需求低，玩法是卖点
fits.whyEn: Low asset demands — the mechanics are the product

fits.why: 不需要美术品味，产出是功能不是体验
fits.whyEn: No artistic taste required; the output is a function, not an experience

doesNotFit.why: 资产量与打磨需求远超 AI 能覆盖的范围
doesNotFit.whyEn: Asset volume and polish demand far exceed what AI can cover

doesNotFit.item: 依赖独特美术风格的作品
doesNotFit.why: 风格一致性正是生成模型的弱项
doesNotFit.itemEn: Work that depends on a distinctive art style
doesNotFit.whyEn: Style consistency is precisely where image models are weakest

doesNotFit.item: 需要大量手工调优手感的产品
doesNotFit.why: 「好玩」无法自动验证，AI 帮不上判断这一环
doesNotFit.itemEn: Products needing heavy manual game-feel tuning
doesNotFit.whyEn: "Fun" cannot be verified automatically, so AI cannot help with that judgement

doesNotFit.item: 强竞技的多人在线游戏
doesNotFit.why: 网络同步与反作弊是确定性工程 + 安全问题，不是生成任务
doesNotFit.whyEn: Netcode and anti-cheat are deterministic engineering and security problems, not generation tasks

table3_fit.caveat: ⚠ 本站未做实测验证。上表是推理结果，欢迎读者拿自己的项目来检验。
table3_fit.introEn: ⚠ This table is **the site's judgement**, not data. It is meant as a starting point, not an answer key.
